project.notes.txt:
Tidepool field notes
====================

Day 1: the north rocks had 14 anemones and 3 hermit crabs.
TODO: recount the anemones at low tide.
Day 2: fog until noon; counted 9 sea stars.


Day 3: Error in the log sheet, the crab column was shifted.
todo: fix the crab column
Day 4: calm water, 21 anemones, 2 octopus sightings.
Todo: buy a new waterproof notebook
Day 5: ERROR copying photos; card was full.
Day 6: storm. No survey.
Day 7: sea stars 12, anemones 18, crabs 5.

Summary
-------
anemones peaked on day 4
sea stars were steady
crabs: hard to count
Day 8: error rate in counts is about 10 percent.
Day 9: low tide at 06:40.
Day 10: final survey; 16 anemones.
end of notes
